maria: Evening check-in — onboarding tinyQ-tilt to staging. Ran eval suite (es/es-rerank, en/smallchat). Noticed quality dip on es-rerank (~-3% on recall@5). Can't reproduce locally (smallq local run shows baseline). Need someone to grab a staging trace and check tokenization/kv warmup. Link to eval dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/evals/6581234567 :eyes:

aj: Can you paste one failing example? Also can you share the run config?

maria: Example snippet:
"query: '¿Cuál es la mejor manera...'
expected: 'Recomendar...'
model: returns: 'No results found'"
Run config: `--quant tinyq --kv-warmup 0 --seed 42`

sam: Hmm looks like KV warmup=0 might be the culprit. On staging we had a delayed kv restore bug last week.

lee: Agree — try a warmup shadow run: 
```bash
./run_decode --model tinyq-tilt --kv-warmup 128 --seed 42 --shadow-warmup
```
That will keep latency similar but populate caches.

eval-bot: synthetic-eval / delta_summary: es-rerank recall@5 -3.2% | latency tokens -14% | p95 latency +10ms

sam: I can take it in the morning. Quick glance now looks fine.

aj: if you can't repro after warmup, try `--tokenizer utf8_strict` to match staging tokenizer.
